dogecoin.text: Coinbase's launch of wrapped XRP and Dogecoin on Base marks a quiet regulatory temperature swing. Users gain DeFi access for previously constrained assets, re-routing potential yield flows through a major exchange's L2. Rain taps mild against server room pane, as capital finds

Czech National Bank eyes 5% Bitcoin reserves. Norway's sovereign fund grew BTC exposure 153% in 2024. ETF filings for Solana and Dogecoin test the SEC's shifting stance. Regulatory drift, a quiet hum, signals a slow rollout of approvals.
